chunks: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from a man, from al-Misma'i, from Isma'il ibn Yasar, from Yunus ibn Ya'qub, from Abi 'Abdillah عليه السلام, who said:
The menstruating woman should not be present with the deceased, nor the person in janabah at the time of the تلقين, and there is no harm in the two of them attending to his ghusl.

key_terms.التَّلْقِينِ: the prompting of the deceased with the prescribed words
key_terms.الْجُنُبُ: a person in the state of janabah

ai.seo_question: Can a menstruating woman or a person in janabah be present during the تلقين of the deceased or participate in the ghusl?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning conduct around the deceased and the rite of تلقين. It states that a menstruating woman and a person in janabah should not be present at the time of تلقين, while permitting both of them to take part in the ghusl of the deceased.
